newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SPECTOR STARS ON EASIER BELGIAN BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: SPECTOR STARS ON EASIER BELGIAN BOURSE.

text.p: The Bel-20 share index started on Tuesday on an easier note after five days of closing highs, but dealers said the bourse was well supported.
"The air is getting thin at these levels, but the market doesn't want to go lower," one dealer said.

Photo group Spector was a top gainer, jumping 4.5 percent to 2.090 francs after U.S. company Nashua Corp said on Monday it was neotiating the sale of its $29 million mainland European film processing operations to Spector.
Generale bank said in a research note that it maintained its 'buy' recommendation on the stock.
It said the acquisition would further add to Spector's good medium-term prospects.
Elsewhere few stocks moves stood out, though overall early Belgian share volume was a reasonable 574 million francs worth.

Political uncertainty after news late on Monday prosecutors want to investigate federal minister Elio Di Rupo in a possible child sex scandal did not have a major impact but remained a background concern, dealers said.
"There's not much worry yet from foreign investors. People get used to seeing the government handle any bad news that comes their way," one added.
